update.name: rapid7-CVE-2026-15409
update.description: This repo contains a proof-of-concept exploit for CVE-2026-15409. It establishes non-root remote code execution on SonicWall SMA 1000 by implementing the Erlang protocol expected by localhost:1050 and tunneling it through the websocket for file r/w and arbitrary code execution via RPC calls.

update.name: CVE-2026-48909-Joomla-SP-Exploit
update.description: CVE-2026-48909 - Unauthenticated PHP Object Injection to RCE exploit for Joomla SP LMS extension versions <= 4.1.3. Exploits lmsOrders cookie deserialization to write webshell via Joomla FormattedtextLogger gadget chain. Includes interactive shell, path discovery, and cleanup. For authorized security testing only.
